stem: A crash seems to originate in a provider plugin's handling of one resource rather than in Terraform's own planning. The engineer wants the most detailed output available, from the plugins only. Which setting fits?
rationale: `TF_LOG_PROVIDER` covers all providers and provider SDKs used during the run, and TRACE is the most verbose level, so together they give the full plugin detail and nothing else. `TF_LOG_CORE` covers the Terraform binary and does not include providers, so it gives core logs, which are the ones the Terraform team needs for core errors. ERROR is the least verbose level, so provider logging at that level is far less detailed than TRACE. Setting both variables to TRACE turns on the plugin logs and also the core logs, so it does not meet the plugins-only requirement.
